Huang Yu sat at the head of the table, with Lin Xiao and Fang Shunli on either side, while Xu Chun was seated further away. The seating arrangement clearly indicated dominance and relationships. It was obvious that Xu Chun, being an outsider, hadn't yet been accepted and needed more time.

Three of the young masters were present, except for the heir of the Bai family. Clearly, he wasn't intended to participate in this conversation. The plan to deal with the Bai family certainly wouldn't involve them; the financial crisis was an opportunity, and survival depended on increasing revenue and cutting costs.

Even with cost-cutting measures, new resources were still needed. "Then let's just swallow one of them whole. After dividing it up, the three major families can all eat their fill. When the financial crisis is over, they'll have figured out some ways to rebuild and rise again. As for the Bai family, who cares about a loser?"

"We can start tomorrow. We'll blockade their real estate market. We'll divide this up, and the other small investors can step aside. The four of us will split it. What do you think?" Huang Yu took out a large crab and divided it into four portions. Two legs went to Xu Chun's plate, the rest were divided equally among the three families, and he got a slightly larger share.

This signified the distribution of the real estate monopoly. Huang Yu took the lion's share, the Lin and Fang families received smaller portions—the smaller portion representing his profits as the leader—while the smaller, less substantial portions went to outsiders like Xu Chun.

Xu Chun was very dissatisfied. Why should everyone contribute their efforts, but only get a tiny share when it comes to the profits? No matter how dissatisfied he was, he dared not express it. This opportunity was rare; if he could secure entry into Hengdu and become one of the four major families, his position as heir would be a foregone conclusion.

"Not bad. Besides real estate, what other industries are there?" Fang Shunli seemed indifferent, having obtained firsthand information. "What about the pharmaceutical industry? Want to take a gamble?"

"Sure. Don't you have a pharmaceutical company? I'll use my connections to promote low-end consumable drugs, distributing them everywhere, from cities to towns, squeezing the Bai family's profits again. Their market share will be yours. I won't interfere in the pharmaceutical industry. Do you have anything to add?" Huang Yu was very generous this time, simply not interfering. The reason was simple: it wouldn't generate much profit. Widespread distribution meant suppressing the market through price wars and sheer volume.

Ordinary low-end drugs are consumables—the IV drips used in hospitals during surgery, glucose, amino acids, saline solution, disinfectants, etc. These are all medical supplies with staggering daily consumption. Seizing market share would be very profitable, but the Bai family practically controls the supply to most hospitals, making it unrealistic to try and take it over.

Unrealistic means very difficult, not hopeless. This process would require significant sacrifices: interpersonal relationships, financial commitments, and a protracted struggle with the Bai family. The Bai family wouldn't just sit idly by and wait to die; they certainly wouldn't relinquish this market.

Considering all these factors, Huang Yu chose to withdraw voluntarily. There were no substantial profits, and even if there were, they would be minimal. It was better to do a favor; a good relationship would make things easier. Besides, this was just one part of a plan to distract the Bai family. If they didn't defend themselves fully, even the aviation industry could be replaced.

Lin Xiao wasn't concerned. "When will you provide the 10 billion needed to cut off the supply? If not, we'll have to start supplying. The Bai family is starting to order large quantities; they're definitely working on leukemia drugs."

Yes, breach of contract requires compensation, and that's 10 billion—the Lin family can afford it. But during the financial crisis, making money was difficult enough, let alone giving away 10 billion. Lin Dongsheng wasn't stupid; he wouldn't interfere rashly without someone else's money.
"Give it to me now, I'll contribute 2 billion," Huang Yu instructed his secretary to begin the transfer.
"I'll also contribute 2 billion, and what about the rest?" Fang Shunli was also contributing money along with Huang Yu; he wasn't going to be a sucker.

chapters.title: Chapter 1074 Huang Meng, the filial son
paragraphs: Xu Chun raised an eyelid, glancing at Huang Yu and Fang Shunli's expressions. He cursed inwardly, "I can only contribute a maximum of 5 billion. Any more and I won't be able to explain it to the board."
That would still leave 1 billion. The Lin family definitely wouldn't contribute 1 billion; they'd still need a scapegoat, a sucker.
"Then I'll personally contribute another 1 billion. I want half of the gas station." Huang Yu wasn't stingy, seizing the opportunity to make an exorbitant demand.
Xu Chun raised an eyelid. "Young Master Yu, isn't that a bit too much?" His unspoken displeasure was clear; being too greedy wouldn't bring any benefit.

"Too much? I don't think it's too much at all. Either we split it in half, or we don't do this project." Huang Yu didn't back down, instead adding a hint of threat. "The Bolin Group can provide high-quality oil; you don't need to worry about rising oil prices."

"Alright, but I want 70% of the construction." Xu Chun seized the opportunity to make his demands. Real estate was indeed profitable, but the foundation was the construction teams. Without construction, how could there be any properties to sell? This is a considerable income; why not seize the market and let others have it?

"Okay, the remaining three floors will go to Shunli. You've worked hard too." Huang Yu, full of confidence, began distributing profits, easily redistributing the industry's gains in the process. They also created a platform, first inviting celebrities from the entertainment industry, then bringing in some foreign babes, building up the platform through every possible channel. They were doing exactly what Zhao An's platform was doing, determined to crush him.

While the Bai family villa was still filled with laughter and joy, the Huang family's courtyard was brightly lit. Business had been busy lately, and they were working quite late. Furthermore, Huang Yu had cultivated relationships with several large conglomerates: three in Europe, two in the Middle East, one in Japan, one in South Korea, and one in the United States. This was practically a conglomerate alliance; no wonder they were so aggressive towards the Bai family—their sheer strength on paper was enough to intimidate.

Inside the Huang family's courtyard house, Huang Meng's face was grim. He arrived at the family residence, but no one greeted him; they all ignored him. People with no status, and who would surely be purged later, what did they care about fratricide? That was all nonsense. Why keep them alive for the New Year?

Seeing the family members showing him no respect, Huang Meng sneered inwardly. His wife, Fang Shuiling, was attending Bai Qingyang's birthday banquet, while he was left to eat the leftovers. It was clear their marriage was in turmoil.

Ignoring everyone else, Huang Meng went to the patriarch's study, which was also his father's office. Inside, his mother, Zhou Haiming, was still discussing something with his father, Huang Li. They both frowned imperceptibly when he entered.
Zhou Haiming asked in a gentle tone, "What is it?"
"I want five million. I want to go on a trip abroad to relax," Huang Meng said, his face still expressionless, seemingly devoid of emotion.

"It's good for him to go out and relax. I'll transfer ten million to you later. Do you have anything else to say?" Zhou Haiming didn't speak harshly; after all, he was her son. Even if he was a eunuch, he was still her son, born after ten months of pregnancy. There was no reason to hold a grudge.

Huang Li, however, was not so patient. He snorted in a gloomy tone, "Now that you have the money, behave yourself. Don't cause trouble, don't waste time, and speak quickly if you have something to say."
"Nothing else." Huang Meng was extremely disgusted with his father and turned to leave.
Bang! The door slammed shut. Huang Li slammed his hand on the table. "He's gone too far! What kind of attitude is that!"

"Sigh, forget it, honey. Let him be. He's quite pitiful. Nobody wanted this to happen. I'll give him the money now so he can go out and relax. That way, it won't affect Huang Yu's plans." Zhou Haiming shook her head. Both were her children; it was just a matter of who felt more pain.

Huang Meng walked straight through the residence to the old house at the back to pay his respects to his grandfather, Old Master Huang. Having to greet the bodyguards at the gate just to see his grandfather was incredibly humiliating. If Huang Yu came, he could simply enter without even a word; that was the difference, the disparity.

After waiting a long time, medical staff finally came to allow Huang Meng to enter, which greatly displeased him. Moreover, even upon entering, he was subjected to a body search, making him feel like he was there to commit a crime.

Old Master Huang sat in a wicker chair reading a newspaper. Beside him was a pot of boiling water, kept warm for making tea. The steaming tea was placed on the table, within easy reach. When Huang Meng entered, he didn't even lift an eyelid, nor did he utter a single word.

Huang Meng was furious. It was this old man who ruled with absolute power, handing over his business to Huang Yu, that foolish brother, with just a single sentence. The situation was beyond his control, so he lowered his head and said, "Grandpa, I want to travel abroad for a while to relax. It's to say goodbye."
"Hmm." Old Master Huang continued reading his newspaper, saying nothing. Silence was the best deterrent; speaking would be pointless.

A hint of murderous intent flashed in Huang Meng's eyes. He stepped forward and poured tea for Old Master Huang. "Grandpa, if you feel unwell and need a doctor, please let me know. I'll ask Zhao An to come see you." As he spoke, a small, colorless, odorless test tube of medicine was poured into the cup. "Grandpa, please have some tea."

"Hmm, if you have nothing else to do, you can leave." Old Master Huang didn't even glance at his grandson. Since he had already offended him, and his grandson dared to be unhappy, then he wouldn't be so lenient.

Huang Meng thought the same thing: this old bastard should die sooner rather than later. "Okay, Grandpa, I'm leaving now. Take care." He turned and left, and at the corner, he tucked the empty test tube into his anus to avoid detection.

The drug he'd just administered was a slow-acting medication; it would take effect in two weeks, and then it wouldn't be detectable. Besides, Grandpa Huang was already ninety years old, and while he seemed as spry and simple as a man, what if something went wrong? No one would suspect a thing!

paragraphs: Thinking of this, Huang Meng almost burst out laughing, but he held it in, remaining expressionless, even when caught on camera. Blame it on that old man's inconsiderate behavior, insisting on meddling in the young people's affairs; he'd make him taste death.

As soon as Old Master Huang died, Huang Meng would immediately rise up, reclaim his power, help Zhao An bring down the Huang family, and become its master. He had already devised a brilliant plan, suggested by Zhao An, who intended it as a trap.

After poisoning the man, Huang Meng left, boarding a plane and heading overseas without any delay. Everything seemed normal. The loser fleeing overseas—the script and trope were exactly like in novels.

In the banquet hall, Bai Qiuqin's pretty face was flushed. Holding a microphone, she walked onto the stage. The sexy dancer from earlier had already left. "Dear guests, I just received some good news, and I'd like to share it with you all at my brother's birthday dinner."

The music stopped, and everyone's eyes were on Bai Qiuqin. Even Bai Qingyang was no exception; he was currently trying to reassure his family members to prevent them from defecting, which would make things difficult. He was a little surprised to hear his sister say this. Had her charm worked?

"I just received news from the researchers that a drug to treat leukemia has been successfully developed. The clinical trials have been excellent. Fifty patients—five in the early stages, fifteen in the middle stages, and thirty in the late stages—have all recovered and been discharged. The treatment effect is very good." Bai Qiuqin finished speaking with a smug expression, her pretty face radiating excitement and pride.

"We will begin production tomorrow, and the patent is also under review. This drug can treat leukemia patients, whether in the early or late stages, and can cure them. It doesn't require surgery, reducing patient suffering and recovery time. We are honored to have Zhao An join us; this is good news, good news for all humanity, and I wanted to share it with you all. Thank you for listening, and please enjoy yourselves tonight." Bai Qiuqin said briefly before leaving the stage, and the girls continued their performance.

The audience below was in an uproar, whispering amongst themselves. This situation could only be described as outrageous! Absurd to the extreme! It seemed the Bai family was about to collapse, and then this powerful boost came along?

What did this mean? It meant the Bai family's pharmaceutical business was rock solid. Unless their reputation exploded, it was a gold standard; others shouldn't even think about competing, and they couldn't—there was no hope.

Leukemia treatment is extremely complicated; cures are rare, and surgery and bone marrow transplants are usually required. Leaving aside the question of whether suitable resources exist, even if they did, the medication required after surgery would be prohibitively expensive. Anti-rejection drugs need to be taken regularly, otherwise death is possible, making this disease extremely difficult to treat.
The leukemia drugs sold by the Huang family are imported, and they are merely agents, which is already astronomically priced. With such exorbitantly priced drugs, what's the point of even trying?

This news directly stabilized some wavering members. With such a strong advantage, as long as they weathered the financial crisis, there would be no further problems. Competition wasn't their concern; their biggest fear was morale collapsing, which would be extremely troublesome.

Zhao An had already returned to the ladies' side, boasting about his research experience. Although he didn't provide many details, he hinted at his unique cosmetics, and Bai Huishan had already been a guinea pig, with the ointment's effects being very distinctive and easily noticeable.
No one would refuse to become younger and more beautiful; it's a tremendous opportunity.

Unfortunately, there was no opportunity or means to obtain it. The two-hundred-million-dollar ointment was already beyond their means, but they all noticed Zhao An's crotch; it was erect, stretching his pants to their limit. They had no doubt that if it weren't for his underwear, that enormous penis would have created a huge tent in his pants, not what it was like now. Even so, it already had a very strong visual impact; it was truly terrifying.
At this moment, a man walked over and said in a calm tone, "Zhao An, my young master requests your presence."
"Screw you, tell him to come here himself," Zhao An retorted immediately. What the hell?

The man's expression changed. He was Fang Shunli's man, and a member of the Fang family; he had some influence. It was already quite generous of him to come and call someone; he didn't expect to be scolded like this. Just as he was about to say something, he was patted on the shoulder.

Fang Shunli approached personally, holding a wine glass. "Zhao An, interested in playing some mahjong? How about a little entertainment? I've heard you're a genius, but we haven't had a chance to sit down and chat. How about we play some now? Do you know how to play mahjong?"

"There's nothing I can't do. Vaginal tightening for women, penis enlargement for men—that's no problem for me. A little mahjong is nothing." Zhao An wasn't surprised at all, his arm around Bai Yue's shoulder, looking frivolous. This arrogant and smug attitude, coupled with the feeling that no one could do anything about it, was enough to make any opponent grit their teeth in anger.
Fang Shunli wasn't surprised. Instead, he gestured for them to join in. "Sure, no problem. This way, please. Let's play a little. A little gambling is fine, just a small game."

Upon entering the private room, where only close associates were allowed, two people were already seated. Huang Yu sat down, seemingly waiting for Zhao An to come to him. "Zhao An, sit here. It's rare for you to have time. What kind of card game do you want to play?"
Lin Xiao didn't go down to play; instead, he sat on the sofa next to him. "I don't know how to play mahjong. Xu Chun, you play."

Xu Chun was somewhat grateful. This was a good opportunity to shine, a perfect chance for him to make a name for himself. Making a name for himself in Hengdu was very important, extremely important. "Thank you."
The other seat naturally went to Fang Shunli. Given the marriage alliance between the Lin and Xu families, it was perfectly normal for Lin Xiao to help Xu Chun.

chapters.title: Chapter 1076 Someone gave money
paragraphs: Zhao An rolled up his sleeves, sat down in a chair, and looked at the mahjong table in front of him. "Alright, what kind of hand?"

This question immediately revealed his expertise. Mahjong is divided into many regions, each with its own unique style and rules. Some regions allow for winning by taking tiles (chow), some don't; some allow taking tiles, some don't. Therefore, determining the hand is the first thing a gambler asks.
"Taiwanese mahjong, I'll say directly, giving the other party no chance."
"How much are you betting?"
Click, Zhao An lit a cigarette, exhaling a satisfying puff. The aroma of the herbs made the air feel fresher. "Don't bet so high. Let's play it small. Ten million as the base, one million per round."

Xu Chun's hand, which was about to bet, stopped. He stared at Zhao An in disbelief. "Do you even have that much money?!" At this price, a single game would cost at least thirty or forty million. What's the point of playing? This is blatant flaunting of wealth!
"Nonsense, I can afford this much. What, you're broke? No money and still want to play mahjong?" Zhao An couldn't stand Xu Chun, his eyes filled with mockery.

Taiwanese mahjong rules are a bit unique. If you discard a tile to form a kong (a set of four identical tiles), as long as you win by drawing the tile yourself, nothing happens. It's not counted. But if you don't win by drawing the tile yourself or someone else wins, then it counts, one "fan" (a unit of currency). In the current situation, that's four million. Four million for each discarded tile to form a kong—just thinking about it is exciting.
This amount of money isn't much to anyone present, but if it continues, and someone has bad luck, losing hundreds of millions in one night isn't a joke.

Bai Qingyang arrived at this moment. "Playing mahjong, huh? A little gambling is harmless. Let's agree beforehand, no getting angry, treat it all as entertainment. It's a great day today, you won't refuse to give me face, will you?" He then patted Zhao An on the shoulder. "Give me face, it's up to you another day." This was a special favor; others didn't receive this treatment. Moreover, as the established head of the Bai family, Bai Qingyang still held considerable influence.
"Okay, no problem." Zhao An was in a good mood today and didn't intend to cause trouble.
"Haha, being able to play mahjong naturally shows good character. A person's character and conduct are easily discernible." Huang Yu chuckled, his eyes probing Zhao An.

Soon, the mahjong game began. Zhao An wasn't unfamiliar with mahjong; on the contrary, he was having a blast, playing strip mahjong. The end result was that the female livestreamers he played with were all thoroughly violated, their vaginas filled with semen.
Upon receiving his cards, Zhao An didn't even pick them up; he merely touched them with his hand. "Ah, really good cards."
Seeing Zhao An's reaction, Xu Chun couldn't help but sneer, "Don't pretend, or you'll lose everything."

"I'm more worried about whether you've washed off the dog shit on you. Did you eat dog shit? Your mouth stinks!" Zhao An retorted immediately. Civilization? That's for people. Xu Chun was nothing but an animal, no, not even human, yet he dared to talk about civilization?
"You!" Xu Chun's eyes flashed with anger, but he held back, saying to a young man beside him, "Old Eight, you watch the cards." He was essentially asking someone to play them.
Bai Yue whispered in Zhao An's ear, "Which one is the Southwest Gambling King? He's famously good at gambling. He's self-proclaimed, but he's very skilled at it. You'd better be careful."
"What bullshit Gambling King? In front of me, he's just a dog, not even as good as a dog." Zhao An's voice wasn't quiet, carrying a hint of mockery.
"Zhao An, you are indeed a genius, but I don't believe you can beat me," Xu Chun sneered. He knew plenty of all sorts of people; pulling off some tricks would be a piece of cake for him.
"One Wan." Huang Yu didn't participate, instead watching with amusement.

"Five Tong." Fang Shunli also played a card, somewhat casually, just playing around anyway. "Zhao An, I heard you have some good ideas for making money. What's the plan? Can you share it? Everyone here has connections; an idea can be implemented quickly."
"Three Tiao." Xu Chun also played a card, but didn't say much, feeling a bit annoyed with Zhao An.

"Sure, five billion for one idea. If you need it, give me the money immediately, and I'll tell you right away." Zhao An finished speaking, then drew a card, his smile widening. "Wow, this is great! Self-draw!" He then turned all his cards over.

"Pure Hand, Lucky Draw, Elephant Eye, Closed Hand, One Draw Five, Double High, Two Hundred Fan. Two hundred million each, pay up." Zhao An's smile was incredibly mocking, carrying an arrogance, the arrogance of a genius. He had been exposed to gambling before when playing erotic games, and after gambling five times, he awakened his gambling skills. Winning couldn't be easier. Besides, he had spiritual energy to cheat; they were nothing but pigs, at the mercy of others.

This completely stunned everyone. A perfect hand right from the start! Was this even fair? A perfect hand was a self-draw on the very first card in the game, usually reserved for those with exceptionally good luck.

Two hundred million in one sentence! This enormous sum left Bai Yue speechless, almost breathless with shock. Two hundred million! Two hundred million per person, three people would be six hundred and thirty million—a windfall!
Sweat beaded on Xu Chun's forehead; he didn't have that much money to squander. "Were you cheating?"
His henchman, Lao Ba, whispered a reminder, "Brother Chun, he wasn't cheating. He's very skilled; I wasn't confident I could win."
Zhao An provided his account number, and funds were quickly transferred in. Large families' accounts were fast, used specifically for transactions.
After receiving the money, Zhao An immediately transferred 30 million to Bai Yue. "Never mind, use the change to buy you clothes."
"Thank you, Young Master An, that's too much." Bai Yue was flattered, truly flattered.
"Buy your mom a few more outfits. With someone sponsoring it, it's not a big deal," Zhao An smiled, then turned to the other three. "So, do the three bosses still want to continue?"

"Continue if you want, I don't mind. It's rare to play mahjong and have some fun," Huang Yu smiled, though he was a little annoyed. Although he didn't care much about money, losing two hundred million at once still bothered him.

paragraphs: "It's not that I don't have ideas, it's just that you can't execute them, and you lack the vision. The initial investment is too much, and I'm too lazy to do it; it's also too much trouble to manage. Besides, I'm not interested in making money; money isn't everything. Only by turning money into knowledge and doing things I'm interested in will it have any effect. As for other things, well, can money save a person?" Zhao An smoked a cigarette and continued playing cards.
This time, he didn't try to win immediately, but played slowly, waiting until he had a good hand before trying to win. He couldn't refuse money offered to him.

This time, Zhao An again didn't reveal his cards, speaking as he played. He had already devised a way to trap his opponents. You know, during the American Gold Rush, who made the most money? Everyone thought it was the gold miners. But the truth is, the ones who made money were the merchants who provided the tools. Whether they mined for gold or not, they sold a lot of tools. Even if they didn't make the most, they were definitely in the middle. Stable profits are the real way to make money. Do you really think making money is about luck? That's called getting rich overnight!

"Self-draw, Mixed Suit, All Pairs, Double High Hand, Concealed Hand. 120 points, 130 million each." Zhao An smiled and flipped over his tiles. Another self-draw. It was just as the other three players had cleared their hands and were waiting to call for a self-draw, only to have Zhao An win. That was the most infuriating thing.
If you couldn't reach it, it would be fine, but to be so close and then have it beaten to it is the most infuriating thing.

Xu Chun's expression wasn't so good anymore. Another 130 million? Damn it, who can afford that? In less than five minutes, almost 400 million had been gone, and he hadn't even earned a penny back. What was the point of playing? "What good way do you have to make money? If you think of anything, just say it. We can help, even though I don't like you. When it comes to making money, there's no such thing as liking or disliking."
"Heh, why should I tell you? Pay up." Zhao An sneered, clearly trying to raise the price.
"Why don't you tell Qingyang that you two don't get along?" Huang Yu's words were a direct attempt to sow discord, without any pretense.

"Haha, business is business, and personal relationships are personal relationships. The Bai family won't interfere in any of its members' affairs. Individual well-being helps everyone else well. Your words are a bit one-sided; you should be punished with three drinks." Bai Qingyang chuckled, changing the subject. He wouldn't accept such low-level attempts to sow discord. One shouldn't be too greedy; enough is enough.
Besides, Zhao An seems difficult to get along with, always blunt and ready to fight at the slightest provocation. However, if you find the right approach, everything is negotiable, very negotiable.
If force doesn't work, try a softer approach. Some people like a gentle approach. A kind and gentle persuasion is always more comfortable and natural than a hard one.

"Haha, you're quite the smooth talker. Mine, mine, I'll punish myself with three drinks." Huang Yu also picked up his red wine and drank. "Come on, let's play a couple more rounds. It's been a long time since I've sat down and had some fun. Spending money to have some fun."

"Looks like I'll have to follow you from now on. You're the trendsetter. Since your debut, everything you do has been top-notch. I admire you. Come on, let me toast you, do as you please." Fang Shunli also picked up his glass and made a toasting gesture. He didn't care about money; achieving the big goal was his top priority.

"Now that you all know about the financial crisis, I won't go into detail. To revive the economy, we need to find demand. You're not interested in opening hair salons, and you're not interested in fast food, so let's do something else." Zhao An continued to play cards, occasionally glancing at Bai Yue's large breasts, giving off a nouveau riche vibe, but a somewhat low-class feeling.

This was an atmosphere Zhao An deliberately created. He had no pursuit or requirements regarding his image. What others thought was insignificant to him. Bearing the title of genius, it's normal for him to do something. Geniuses are always eccentric, aren't they?
"You mean starting with food, clothing, shelter, and transportation?" Xu Chun wasn't stupid; he understood immediately. But what was the key?

"Looks like you're not stupid after all. Alright, since that's the case, then you understand. Since you understand, I won't say any more." Zhao An smiled mockingly, casually playing cards, smoking, and drinking.
"You!" Xu Chun almost spat out blood in anger. He'd never seen such shamelessness. They'd brought the topic to this point, and then he said he wasn't going to do it anymore. What was this?

"Interesting. Tell me your good plan. I'm really looking forward to your ideas." Huang Yu was also somewhat surprised. Although a full-scale attack on the Bai family was a fact, getting better profits from it was also a good thing. Destroying Zhao An's platform wouldn't be easy; it required being prepared to burn money for a long time. This was about using capital to suppress them.
If it's the real economy, it's easy to suppress because there are clear targets. But the internet economy is a different story; cracking down on this industry is much more difficult.

"Self-draw, pure hand, all pairs, winning on a kong, concealed hand, five-of-a-kind, two hundred points, pay up." Zhao An finished speaking and flipped the tiles over again. "Oh, that's two hundred and ten million in total, pay up."

Who would dare play this kind of mahjong? In less than ten minutes of these three rounds, over a billion had already been lost. Zhao An was making a fortune, but the other three players were losing so much they were practically broke.

Xu Chun's forehead was covered in cold sweat. He couldn't keep going like this. If they played for an hour, wouldn't he lose five or six billion at this rate? "I'm done playing. You've got good luck. If I don't play, who will?"

"Since that's the case, how about we bet something more exciting? You can bet something special—it could be an industry, a company, land, or even a woman." Zhao An's eyes flickered, slowly luring the other party into his trap.

This made everyone present pause. Good heavens, is he addicted to gambling? A good piece of land can generate much more economic value; that's not just a matter of a couple hundred million, but tens of billions. Is this gambling? This is high-stakes gambling! Win and you'll be living the high life; lose and you'll commit suicide by jumping into the sea!

Zhao An didn't refuse, offering his first chip: "The age of electrification has arrived; everything is about strategy. I can give the winner a three-year right to use my invention, a hydroelectricity conversion technology, without paying me any patent royalties."
This condition was quite tempting. Zhao An's new energy invention wasn't unheard of; it had been demonstrated at Huang Meng's party, using water entirely for energy conversion.

"Is your energy source tap water, purified water, or seawater?" Fang Shunli asked a crucial question, because Fang Shuiling had revealed that Zhao An's energy source was seawater, meaning the cost was extremely low. "Production only needs to be done near the sea; seawater is no problem at all—it's incredibly simple and cheap."

"Seawater is best, tap water is so-so, and purified water has the worst conversion efficiency." Zhao An wasn't afraid to say it aloud. Even if he did, no one else could crack the code. That's the advantage of technological monopoly; no one else knows it, only he does, and even if he explained it, no one would understand. It's a crushing victory of intelligence and knowledge.
"I'm betting. Iron Bull Plaza on Iron Bull Street." Fang Shunli offered his bid readily and immediately placed it.
A murmur rippled through the crowd. "Iron Bull Plaza has a great location! Monthly revenue could reach 300 million!"
"That's a huge investment. Too bad I don't have the money. If I did, I'd place a bet."
"Having money but no experience is just gambling; it's about the thrill. If you're not at the right level, don't meddle."
Indeed, this was a high-stakes gamble. Win, and you have everything. Lose, and the price is heavy. Such gambles are rare; it's all about the thrill and the potential profit.
"Well, it's definitely a heart-pounding gamble. People with heart conditions should absolutely not participate; it's easy to have a heart attack and die."
Huang Yu's eyes flickered a few times. "Then I'll bet on Nonghua Plaza on Nonghua Street."

A collective gasp rippled through the crowd; they were clearly shocked. Nonghua Plaza was a major real estate highlight for the Huang family, each plaza guaranteeing over 500 million in revenue per month. The plaza Huang Yu had bet on was a top-three property, a luxury plaza with a monthly income exceeding 1.5 billion—truly a big shot.
"Amazing! No wonder he's Young Master Yu."
"So rich! My goodness! This is a win-win situation!"
"One plaza, and you won't have to worry about the rest of your life even if you break your leg."

Undoubtedly, Huang Yu's offer was very sincere; compared to what he paid, what he received was the best outcome. Whoever got the new energy patent first would make a fortune. They weren't afraid of Zhao An openly giving them opportunities; what they feared was Zhao An quietly making a killing, accumulating wealth in silence—that was the hardest thing to defend against. They couldn't stop this tide, nor did they have the right.

Now, all eyes were on Xu Chun. Whether it was Zhao An, Fang Shunli, or Huang Yu, the prices they offered were all heart-pounding. Win and you'd get a hostess model; lose and you'd be forced into prostitution. Xu Chun was still struggling with whether to gamble. Going all in—that was the most exciting part.
Gritting his teeth, Xu Chun said, "I'll go with it, but not mahjong. We'll play poker, all in."

"No problem. What chips can you offer? Trying to get something for nothing? You're overthinking it." Zhao An wasn't flustered at all. Instead, he exhaled smoke rings and said in a mocking tone. This time, he was going to make a fortune.
Xu Chun gritted his teeth. "The Liudunli Coal Mine, I'm giving it up."
"A coal mine?"
"How much is it worth?"
"It seems to be a small coal mine. It's been abandoned since the accident. That's a bit unfair."
The other family heirs watching the scene whispered among themselves. They certainly wouldn't dare to point fingers openly, but they could certainly offer their opinions from the sidelines.
Zhao An scoffed. "Who wants your lousy coal mine? It's been abandoned for years, it's probably moldy inside. If you don't have any stakes, get out of here. Nobody wants to play with you."
"Then what do you want?" Xu Chun gritted his teeth again. "I also have a media company with over two hundred actors. You can have them all."
"Two hundred prostitutes? I don't like wearing worn-out shoes, trash." Zhao An was still incredibly disgusted.

"So what do you want? Don't push your luck." Xu Chun genuinely didn't have much money; he was indeed a bit strapped for cash. Most of his businesses were owned by the eighteen families, and he couldn't possibly use them as a wager. This alone put him far ahead of top-tier playboys like Huang Yu.
True playboys don't lack money or connections. Before inheriting the family headship, they can even be a little frivolous. They can play however they want; what kind of youth isn't a little wild?

Zhao An glanced at the people behind Huang Yu, stroking his chin. "I heard you got married—no, engaged. Oh well, it's pretty much the same anyway. How about using your fiancée as a wager? If I win, I get to play with her for a year, how about that?"
Bang! Xu Chun slammed his hand on the table, his face flushed. No man can tolerate a cuckold, not even his fiancée. "What are you saying? Do you want to die?"

"Xu Chun, it's just about the bet. You can talk it over slowly. If you can't reach an agreement, don't play. You don't want to cause trouble at my birthday party, do you?" Bai Qingyang strongly supported Zhao An. He was just there to watch the show; so far, Zhao An had won big. Although he was worried about the new energy issue, it wasn't limited to one company, so there was still room for negotiation. At most, everyone would be on a level playing field.
Xu Chun's expression changed. Now wasn't the time to lose face, so he paused. "Let me think about it." He turned to look at Lin Xiao, who was chatting and laughing.
Lin Xiao noticed the other's gaze and then nodded subtly, meaning he agreed.
"Okay, I'll go with you." Xu Chun had made up his mind. So what if he was cheated on? He could just not touch her again. Everyone has a mistress, right?

chapters.title: Chapter 1079 Another bet
paragraphs: Zhao An, however, changed his mind again, picking up his wine glass. "It seems a woman isn't worth that much. She might even have been used before."

"What exactly do you want!" Xu Chun slammed his hand on the mahjong table. He wasn't going to pretend anymore; he couldn't keep up the act. This despicable trash—if he were one of the Four Young Masters, he might let it go, but this nobody dared to talk back to him? How could he tolerate this? If he did, how would he ever face anyone again? What would others think of him?

"Who are those two behind you?" Zhao An gestured towards the two women behind him. Both were wearing cheongsams, one older, one younger; one a mature woman, the other a socialite—they looked like mother and daughter.
"My aunt and my cousin." A bad feeling rose in Xu Chun's heart. "Kid, don't try anything funny."

"Then add them both. Play for me for a year. Of course, the premise is that I can win." Zhao An immediately raised the price again, provoking the other party. His expression still carried a hint of mockery, completely disregarding everything. He only cared about himself, extremely self-centered, and didn't take anyone seriously. Such a person was very difficult to deal with. Unless you could touch on a topic that interested him, you would never know how to start a conversation.
"You! You're asking for death, aren't you!" Xu Chun couldn't hold back anymore and wanted to hit him. If it weren't for Lao Ba holding him back, he might have really been beaten up.

"You call yourself the heir? You have no guts. No money, no connections, tsk tsk tsk, what a piece of trash. You want to be a top star like this? If you don't have money, don't try to gamble. You're a piece of trash!" Zhao An sneered, his expression full of contempt.
Xu Chun was furious. He slammed his hand on the table. "Fine, I'll bet you. If I win, you have to give me your patent tonight, immediately!"

"No problem, I won. Tonight I'll play with your wife, your elders, your cousin, haha! And don't forget the 2 billion bet. Call your fiancée over; who knows if you'll renege on your promise." Zhao An finished speaking and took out his phone. With a tap, a holographic projection appeared. This scene made everyone's eyes light up. This technology had transcended the realm of imagination. What was this? What did it mean? If they could get their hands on this technology, it would be a huge business opportunity!

Zhao An quickly began explaining, "The idea behind new energy is to convert it into electricity. If it's an electric car, it only needs water to complete a long journey. If it's a tram or other machine, it's much simpler; just connect it to a water tank. It can be used in industry and production. If used well, an entire residential area could be equipped with this, even saving on electricity bills."
While Zhao An was explaining, Xu Chun communicated with Lin Xiao, who then sent someone to bring Lin Yuanyuan over as a wager. This was a huge investment; losing would be a laughing stock.

Similarly, Huang Yu and Fang Shunli also invited professional casino personnel to give them some advice. After all, gambling with billions or even tens of billions of dollars is truly rare. Even they would feel the pinch, but gambling was fine; losing would hurt, but it would also provide valuable information.

"If you win tonight, can you share your business idea? You've already won; you won't be stingy, will you?" Huang Yu was also prepared for both outcomes; winning or losing, he would benefit. "Yes, you're so lucky, we're almost overwhelmed. You're really lucky," Fang Shunli emphasized, highlighting his own luck. What else could it be but luck? Otherwise, he wouldn't even be qualified to compete with them.

"No problem, it depends on my mood. I was going to do this kind of business anyway. If you lose, I can tell you as a prize. If I lose, I can make it back with this idea, hehe, I won't lose either way," Zhao An continued to entice, certain of his victory. Moreover, this idea was a clever trick to rip people off; initially, it would have great momentum and promise, a bright future.

However, it would hit a bottleneck in the middle stage, and in the later stages? There was no later stage; it would barely survive in the middle. Only the initial stage would be extremely good, the situation would be fantastic, and all kinds of investment would come in. This is what the sharing economy is all about—shared bikes, shared cars, shared umbrellas, etc. It seems like a thriving business, but the result is death; the economy can't keep up.

Supply exceeds demand, then it's a slow death. A lot of investment goes in, but no money is made, and there's no result. And who profited? The bicycle manufacturers profited. Even if payments were delayed later, they had already made a fortune upfront.
This was somewhat appealing; making money regardless of winning or losing was quite satisfying.

"Then why don't you do it yourself? You have the capability; if not, you can have Qingyang do it just as well," Lin Xiao, sitting some distance away, suddenly spoke up. He sensed something was amiss, but couldn't quite put his finger on it.
"I am doing it, it's already started, I just haven't told you," Zhao An chuckled, looking down. "It's not too late to get involved now, but who knows what will happen later."
Shortly afterward, Lin Yuanyuan was brought over by Lin Xiao's men, her expression extremely cold. Only after seeing the smirking Zhao An did she understand something.
Lin Mei'e stepped forward, "Let me chat with you, Young Master Yang. Could you arrange a room for us?"

"Of course! Someone, take Miss Lin and this lady to the guest rooms to rest." Bai Qingyang seemed to realize something. Such a grand gesture, seemingly just for women, was actually a trap. If Xu Chun lost, things would be dire. The mature woman was Xu Chun's aunt, and the beautiful woman beside her was his cousin, married to another family in the Southwest Chamber of Commerce. If she were given to Zhao An for a year, it would be a huge mess, and would greatly impact the internal relations of the Southwest Chamber of Commerce.

Yan Ailing was somewhat surprised by her nephew Xu Chun's decision and wanted to object, but after seeing Xu Chun's shake of his head, she understood. This nephew was the type to deny everything if he lost; she just needed him as a hostage. So, she left with her daughter Xu Yingyue and Lin Yuanyuan to wait in the guest rooms upstairs. If he lost, he'd run away; if he won, he'd take the benefits—he could just cheat. This kind of behavior of betraying female elders is a bit too much. I will definitely talk to my husband about it when I get back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1080 Crazy betting game
paragraphs: Trying to run away and act like a rogue? That tactic wouldn't work at all. Zhao An knew exactly what Xu Chun wanted. Don't forget, after five conversations, he had already unlocked Xu Chun's interface, allowing him to understand Xu Chun's mindset towards him at any time. Huang Yu and Fang Shunli were betting with him with the mindset that they couldn't lose no matter what. If he had refused to reveal how to make money earlier, the next moment they would have said they had something to do and refused to continue gambling.

And this mentality played right into Zhao An's hands. They thought they were on the third level, but Zhao An was actually on the fifth level; they were bound to be manipulated no matter what. They thought they had seen through Zhao An's plan and were cutting their losses on both sides, but in reality, they were only losing more.

Zhao An always calculated things thoroughly. So what if they came from a powerful family? Even top-tier young masters were still at his mercy. Today, he wanted everything—money and people. He would have sex with their relatives, their female relatives, right in front of them. This act excited him; the feeling of scheming and plotting successfully was incredibly exhilarating.

The thought of recruiting talented individuals, this overtly calculated scheme, excited Zhao An so much that his penis became hard. The women all noticed Zhao An's exaggeratedly bulging crotch, unable to imagine the enormous dragon hidden within. If it could be inserted into those cunts, wouldn't it be so pleasurable it make them faint?
A professional dealer arrived and moved the mahjong table aside to begin dealing the cards. "Gentlemen, please check your cards."

Huang Yu and Fang Shunli also had a casino employee beside them, someone who worked in the casino to prevent cheating. They were all intently watching the cards, watching for any possible manipulation.
After watching for a while, Lao Ba behind Huang Yu nodded. "No problem."
Zhao An didn't even bother to glance at them. "Then let's get started."
"Cut the cards once before dealing," the man behind Huang Yu said in a steady tone.
"Cut them again," the man behind Fang Shunli repeated.
Xu Chun turned to his subordinate and asked, "Why aren't you cutting the cards?"

"Brother Chun, there's no need. Cutting the cards is just to prevent people from forming hands. One person can cut many times, but two cuts are usually enough," Lao Ba explained. He was under immense pressure; he couldn't believe the consequences of losing this kind of gambling.
After cutting the cards twice, the dealer began dealing them in order. The first card was face down, and each of the four players held one card.

Zhao An didn't look at the cards; he was still playing on his phone, chatting with his women in a chat group, occasionally popping up to comment, not really focusing on the gambling. He only glanced at it occasionally before continuing to play on his phone.

Zhao An didn't really understand or like Texas Hold'em. Sometimes gambling is quite complex, having developed into a kind of culture. The essence of Texas Hold'em is the hole cards; after confirming the strength of one's five cards, psychological warfare is used to make the opponent hesitate to call.

The rules this time are five rounds. Whoever wins the most rounds wins. If the number of wins is the same, the two players gamble again. There will be a maximum of six rounds, so it won't be slow. There's no need to raise, no need for any strategies, just waiting for the cards. After five cards are dealt, the cards are revealed, so there's no psychological warfare involved.

"Fold." Zhao An didn't even reveal his cards, immediately folding the first round, still playing on his phone, seemingly unconcerned. His expression remained unchanged; it was unclear whether he was putting on a brave face or was truly confident.
"Folding the first round?"
"That doesn't make sense. The hand is pretty good: four of spades, eight of hearts, Jack of diamonds, Ace of clubs. Folding like that?"
"Maybe Zhao An doesn't know how to play cards at all, otherwise, there's no reason for him to play like that."
The other three players were also stunned, not expecting him to fold so decisively. Does he even know how to play?
"Are you sure you want to fold?" the dealer asked, needing to confirm.
"Confirm your fold. Enough talk, let's finish the next round." Zhao An waved his hand impatiently.
After the cards were revealed, the winner of this round was Xu Chun! Zhao An's hand, even when revealed, couldn't beat him. His calculations were superior, but since he folded, it was invalid.
Xu Chun grinned maliciously after winning. "I'm so stupid. I should have let you bet your woman too. Don't blame me for being ruthless then."

Zhao An put his arm around Bai Yue's shoulder, put down his phone, and took out a cigarette. Bai Yue obediently lit the cigarette for him, then nestled in his arms. "I can handle my own woman. As for your fiancée, I'll definitely treat her well. Buy one get one free, get ready to be a father!"
"Heh, I'll wait then." Xu Chun didn't want to waste any more words. His chances of winning were incredibly high, practically off the charts.
In the second round, Zhao An again folded after looking at his cards. Turning to Bai Yue, he whispered sweet nothings, "Do you believe I'll win three rounds in a row?"

"You! I'll beat you to death!" Xu Chun was about to make a move but was stopped; naturally, he wouldn't let him act recklessly.
Lin Xiao also walked over. "It was just a joke, don't take it seriously, Zhao An, give me some face, just treat it as a joke."

Lin Xiao's eyes turned incredibly fierce. "So you mean there's no room for negotiation? Young man, don't be so competitive; you'll suffer a great loss."

Huang Yu, with his magnanimous spirit, said, "I always keep my word. Come to my company tomorrow to sign the contract."
"Me too, come to my company to sign the transfer contract." Fang Shunli lit a cigarette; tonight was certainly exciting. "Let's talk about something else then."

"I'm not interested in these things, Brother Qingyang. Just send someone to follow up, and I'll get the cash back later." Zhao An had no interest in real estate; he had plenty of houses, even a villa. What was this?

"There are many ways to make money: huge profits from a single transaction, small profits from multiple transactions. I'm talking about the latter method: small profits, quick turnover.
